title: Tiger cub wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='70' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ffd08a'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='28' fill='#f7a838'/>

  <circle cx='27' cy='26' r='8' fill='#f7a838'/>

  <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='7' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#ffe0b0'/>

  <rect x='24' y='40' width='22' height='13' rx='5' fill='#2b1a4d'/>
